request: Please retrieve my most recent oxygen saturation value.
independent_notes: One explicit latest metric. No clinical interpretation or provider restriction.

request: Fetch total sleep from February 28 to February 29, 2024.
independent_notes: Valid leap-year interval and trailing explicit year must bind both endpoints.

request: Show sleep efficiency from Oura over the past 14 days.
independent_notes: Retain authorized source and rolling day interval together.

request: Retrieve Garmin steps for February 2026.
independent_notes: Provider-qualified whole month; February 2026 has 28 days.

request: Fetch respiratory rate for the last 3 weeks.
independent_notes: Rolling weeks are represented by their exact number of days.

request: Show ApoB from December 30 to January 2, 2025.
independent_notes: Trailing year belongs to January endpoint; named December start is the preceding year.

request: Retrieve my latest 2 lab reports.
independent_notes: Retain latest-record limit and lab exam-date ordering.

request: Fetch my latest 3 workouts in June 2024.
independent_notes: Both historical month and latest-N record limit are required.

request: Show health appointments due in December 2026.
independent_notes: Future due-date lookup is representable; it is not a health forecast.

request: Fetch health appointments completed today.
independent_notes: Current civil day with completion date basis; native wrapper must retain whole-day calendar bounds.

request: Please show only my allergies.
independent_notes: Explicit field projection must not expand to the entire profile.

request: And the year before that?
independent_notes: Unambiguous follow-up decrements the explicit historical year; it must not substitute the current year.

request: Show my latest ApoB and tell me whether I should increase my statin dose.
independent_notes: Medication decision is not represented by read-only plan; fetching one marker would drop the requested clinical decision.

request: Retrieve LDL cholesterol for 2025 and compute the percentage change from its first to last result.
independent_notes: Arithmetic operation and endpoint comparison must not be silently replaced by a trend read.

request: Show the three highest oxygen saturation readings in July 2025.
independent_notes: Value-ranked top-N metric selection is unsupported; latest ordering would change the question.

request: Read my partner's lab reports using my account permissions.
independent_notes: A different data subject cannot be represented or authorized by the current user inventory.

request: Show my latest ApoB and email the result to my employer.
independent_notes: Outbound disclosure/action is absent from this closed read contract; no partial fast-path plan.

request: Delete my workouts from June 2024 and then show my steps.
independent_notes: Destructive write plus read cannot become a partial read-only plan.

request: Retrieve my latest ApoB and LDL cholesterol values.
independent_notes: Unavailable second metric must cause a handoff rather than a partial ApoB plan.

request: Show my steps from Fitbit for the past 14 days.
independent_notes: Requested source is not in the admitted Oura/Garmin source inventory.

request: Fetch my latest 2 lab reports from the available records.
independent_notes: Labs record category is not admitted in this request; broad wording cannot grant it.

request: Show respiratory rate from February 28 to February 29, 2025.
independent_notes: Invalid non-leap-year end date must not be clipped or broadened.

request: Show my steps between 03/04/2025 and 05/04/2025.
independent_notes: No locale/date-order hint: month-first and day-first interpretations produce different valid windows; require native clarification.

request: Show my sleep efficiency in June 2025, excluding all weekends.
independent_notes: Weekday exclusion is not represented by the date interval schema and must not disappear.
